summary: This excerpt from Kate Douglas Wiggin's novel (Book 11, part 133) follows Rebecca, who receives a telegram that her mother has had a bad accident and hurries to Sunnybrook. Her mother fell from the haymow while supervising barn changes, fracturing her right knee and straining her back, though she is conscious and not in immediate danger. The passage then shifts to a conversation between aunts Miranda and Jane about the family's future, including who will care for Aurelia and the children and the disposition of Miranda's brick house. The note also contains an unrelated sentence about Gary seeing the 'Garden of Earthly Delights' painting in 2013, which appears to be stray text.
one_line: Rebecca rushes to Sunnybrook after her mother's haymow fall, and aunts Miranda and Jane discuss the family's future and Miranda's brick house.
key_facts: Rebecca receives a telegram from Hannah reading: "Come at once. Mother has had bad accident."
Rebecca is started on her way to Sunnybrook in less than an hour after the telegram arrives.
Rebecca's mother had been standing on the haymow superintending some changes in the barn when she was seized with giddiness and slipped.
The right knee of Rebecca's mother was fractured and her back was strained and hurt.
Rebecca's mother was conscious and in no immediate danger, according to Rebecca's letter to aunt Jane.
Miranda was not able to sit up on the day of the discussion and says she could never lay abed without Aurelia getting sick too.
Miranda says "Aurelia was born unfortunate" and predicts Aurelia will probably be a cripple.
Aunt Jane says "Her first duty 's to her mother" regarding Rebecca.
Miranda says "Nobody remembers anything they'd ought to,—at seventeen," in response to Jane.
Miranda asks whether Jane wants to take Aurelia and the children to the brick house after Miranda is dead.
Miranda names the children as Aurelia, Jenny, and Fanny, and says she will not have Mark, who should go to Hannah.
Miranda asks Jane not to tell Rebecca that she has willed her the brick house, saying Rebecca won't get it until Miranda is gone.
Jane says she does not want to be thanked and expects Rebecca will use the front stairs as commonly as the back.
A separate, unrelated sentence in the note states that in 2013 Gary waited in line for hours and then saw the original 'Garden of Earthly Delights' painting up close.
